• Aṅguttara Nikāya 10.125 Numbered Discourses 10.125
  • 13. Parisuddhavagga 13. Purified

Tatiyasutta Third

“Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhammā mahapphalā mahānisaṁsā, nāññatra sugatavinayā. “Mendicants, these ten things are not very fruitful and beneficial apart from the Holy One’s training. Katame dasa? What ten? Sammādiṭṭhi …pe… sammāvimutti—Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom. ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā mahapphalā mahānisaṁsā, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti. These are the ten things that are not very fruitful and beneficial apart from the Holy One’s training.”

Tatiyaṁ.
